explanations.universe_selection: Choose candidates from the Dataset Universe selected above.
explanations.alpha: Produce scores or signals for the selected candidates.
explanations.portfolio_construction: Propose holdings when the selected policy calls for an update. Built-in Top-N uses the selection and sizing settings below.
explanations.risk_management: Inspect actual holdings and the new proposal at every Close. Adjustments combine into one final target before execution.

authoring.order: Each Close: Universe → Alpha / Signals → Portfolio → Risk → final target.
authoring.stopLossHelp: Leave blank to disable. Uses actual acquisition cost including buy fees. Checks at Close and attempts to sell at the next Open; gaps or trading restrictions can increase the loss.
authoring.maximumHoldingHelp: Leave blank to disable. The first actual buy counts as session 1. At the Nth Close, request an exit at the next Open. Adding shares does not restart the count.
authoring.minimumHoldingHelp: Leave blank to disable. Younger holdings retain their shares and occupy portfolio slots during ordinary changes. Risk exits can still reduce or sell them.

python.signature: decide(context, state, parameters) → output and state
python.fieldsHelp: Canonical field IDs, separated by commas or new lines. Only declared fields are available to the program.
python.historyHelp: Includes the decision day. Earlier sessions provide warmup without moving the research start date.
python.directExample: The initial example replaces a holding only when another visible candidate has better momentum. Parameters set the required improvement.
python.historyContext: context.history contains declared fields, with rows in instruments order and columns in sessions order, through the current Close. Missing values are None.
python.context: context.candidates, context.account, context.fills and context.rejections are read-only. Return {{noUpdate}} for no update from this {{unit}}. A target contains reason, allocation and position_limits; weights use exact ratio strings such as "1/2".
python.frameworkContext: context.framework contains the selected universe, active signals, universe_changed, signals_updated, expired_signals, removed_signals, this Close’s proposal and the last retained_proposal. A retained proposal is a reference, not a new order.
python.state: State must be a JSON object and is restored explicitly each day. Source, parameters, data requirements and the execution environment are frozen when accepted. Execution uses the next trading session’s Open.

framework.universe_selection: Return {reason, instrument_ids} to select available Dataset candidates. None retains the previous available selection, initially empty. The example includes all current candidates.
framework.alpha: Return {reason, signals}. Each signal has instrument_id, value and valid_for_sessions (1–252). The host stamps its creation session. None retains unexpired signals. Expiry does not itself sell a holding. The example publishes six-session momentum signals.
framework.portfolio_construction: Return a target or None. The example buys a better-scoring candidate only when the improvement threshold is met, using current holdings and active signals. No update leaves holdings and drift unchanged.
framework.risk_management: Runs every Close, even without a new proposal. Return {mode: "limit_positions", reason, position_limits} to cap held shares; unspecified positions keep their shares when there is no proposal. Return {mode: "replace", reason, target} to replace the proposal, or target: None to cancel it. None leaves the new proposal unchanged. The example exits only symbols listed in exit_instruments; an empty list makes no adjustment.

cost.title: Fees and slippage
cost.help: Frozen for this backtest and its DailyTrack. Defaults are simulation assumptions; actual broker and historical charges may differ.

helpText.commission_min_cny: Applied separately to each filled child order, including split orders.
helpText.slippage_bps: 10 bp raises buy prices and lowers sell prices by 0.1%. Must be below 10,000 bp.

drawdown.title: Portfolio drawdown
drawdown.help: Leave all three fields blank to disable. When enabled, complete every field. Close account value is compared with the current risk-cycle peak; the next Open applies the stock exposure cap.
drawdown.recovery: Cooldown starts after the trigger day. Recovery also requires a new portfolio decision; it never buys back from an old target. The cap only reduces higher targets. Execution can be blocked, and the main Open performance history is not reset.

takeProfit.title: Cumulative take profit
takeProfit.help: Off when no tiers are configured. At the first trigger, freeze the holding baseline. A 30% tier followed by 60% sells another 30% of that baseline, not 60% of the remaining shares. Ordinary selections cannot add shares until this holding fully exits.
takeProfit.footer: Both percentages must increase with each tier. Checks use acquisition cost at Close; fills at the following Open determine actual progress. Blocked sales and rounding remain uncompleted.

frozen.feesHelp: Minimum commission applies to each filled child order. Slippage changes execution prices and is not charged again as a fee.
frozen.drawdownSummary: Threshold {{threshold}}%; stock exposure cap {{cap}}%; cooldown {{cooldown}} trading sessions. A fresh portfolio decision is required for recovery.
frozen.baseline: Baseline freezes at the first trigger. No ordinary additions until full exit.
frozen.evaluated: Evaluated at Close; the next Open determines execution.

state.help: Signals and module state inform later decisions. They do not represent orders or fills.

closeRisk.title: Close risk and holdings
closeRisk.help: Uses closing prices for risk decisions. Performance charts and returns use post-Open NAV.

decision.retained: Retain previous holdings: {{stocks}}. Only remaining cash follows these weights; risk adjustments may still exit.
decision.cap: Stock target cap {{percent}}%; only higher targets are reduced.
decision.close: {{session}} Close decision. The final target executes at the next Research Session Open.
decision.universeRetained: No new selection today; retain still-available candidates
decision.signalsRetained: No new signals today; retain unexpired signals
decision.signalsHelp: The portfolio module evaluates signal changes; they do not automatically create sell orders.
decision.signalRow: {{stock}}: {{value}} · created {{session}} · valid for {{count}} Research Sessions including creation
decision.retentionRow: {{stock}}: held {{age}} Research Sessions, below minimum {{minimum}}. Retain {{shares}} shares and one portfolio slot. Risk adjustments may still reduce or exit.
decision.limitHelp: Local caps limit listed holdings; the portfolio drawdown cap also limits overall stock exposure.
decision.stopLossValues: Remaining acquisition cost {{cost}} CNY; Close research market value {{value}} CNY.
decision.maximumReached: Maximum holding period reached: {{count}} Research Sessions.
decision.positionAtDecision: Held {{shares}} shares for {{age}} Research Sessions at decision. Exit attempted at next Open; related records show actual fills and rejections.
decision.cancelled: Explicitly cancelled today’s portfolio proposal; no new target is created.
decision.targetFormed: Final target formed; see related records for actual fills or rejections.
decision.noTarget: No new target formed; no automatic rebalance follows.

statuses.awaiting_new_portfolio: Cooldown complete; awaiting a new portfolio decision
statuses.new_portfolio_recovery: New portfolio decision released the drawdown cap

drawdownFacts.title: Portfolio drawdown · {{status}}
drawdownFacts.cycle: Risk cycle began {{start}}; Close Risk NAV {{nav}} CNY and cycle peak {{peak}} CNY.
drawdownFacts.triggered: Triggered {{date}}; completed {{completed}} / {{total}} cooldown trading sessions since.
drawdownFacts.noCap: No portfolio drawdown exposure cap applies now.
drawdownFacts.cap: Stock target cap {{percent}}%; lower targets are not raised.
drawdownFacts.release: Releasing the cap permits only a new portfolio target to execute; it does not mean actual exposure has recovered. Next Open fills, rejections and holdings show the outcome. The main report still uses Open NAV and its historical maximum drawdown is not reset.

takeProfitFacts.baseline: Initial baseline {{shares}} shares ({{units}} research holding units); cumulative target retains {{target}} units.
takeProfitFacts.executed: Actually sold {{sold}} units; {{remaining}} units remain to reduce. Research holding units and execution shares are measured separately; rejected and rounded unfilled amounts do not count as complete.
takeProfitFacts.ended: This holding cycle ended; a later decision may re-enter.
takeProfitFacts.active: Held {{shares}} shares at decision; ordinary additions are forbidden during this take-profit cycle until full exit. A reduction is attempted at next Open; related records show actual fills and rejections.

explanations.universe_selection: 从上方选择的数据集股票池中挑选候选。
explanations.alpha: 为选定的候选生成评分或信号。
explanations.portfolio_construction: 按所选规则提出持仓建议。内置 Top-N 使用下方的选股和仓位设置。
explanations.risk_management: 每个收盘时检查实际持仓和新建议。风险调整会在执行前合并为一个最终目标。

authoring.order: 每次收盘：股票池 → Alpha／信号 → 组合 → 风险 → 最终目标。
authoring.stopLossHelp: 留空表示关闭。使用含买入费用的实际取得成本。收盘检查并尝试在下一开盘卖出；跳空或交易限制可能扩大亏损。
authoring.maximumHoldingHelp: 留空表示关闭。首次实际买入计为第 1 个交易日；第 N 个收盘时请求下一开盘退出。追加持仓不会重新计数。
authoring.minimumHoldingHelp: 留空表示关闭。未满期限的持仓在普通调仓中保留股数并占用组合名额；风险退出仍可减仓或卖出。

python.signature: decide(context, state, parameters) → 输出与状态
python.fieldsHelp: 使用字段的正式 ID，以逗号或换行分隔。程序只能读取声明的字段。
python.historyHelp: 包含决策当日。更早的交易日用于预热，不改变研究起始日期。
python.directExample: 初始示例仅在可见候选具有更强动量时替换持仓；所需的改善幅度由参数决定。
python.historyContext: context.history 包含已声明字段；行按 instruments 顺序、列按 sessions 顺序排列，覆盖至当前收盘。缺失值为 None。
python.context: context.candidates、context.account、context.fills 和 context.rejections 只读。此{{unit}}无需更新时返回 {{noUpdate}}。目标包含 reason、allocation 和 position_limits；权重使用 "1/2" 等精确比例字符串。
python.frameworkContext: context.framework 包含选定的 universe、活跃 signals、universe_changed、signals_updated、expired_signals、removed_signals、本次收盘的 proposal 和上次 retained_proposal。保留的建议仅是引用，不是新委托。
python.state: 状态必须是 JSON 对象，每日显式恢复。源码、参数、数据需求和执行环境在接纳时冻结。执行使用下一交易日开盘。

framework.universe_selection: 返回 {reason, instrument_ids} 选择可用的数据集候选。None 会保留上一次可用选择；初始为空。示例包含全部当前候选。
framework.alpha: 返回 {reason, signals}。每条信号包含 instrument_id、value 和 valid_for_sessions（1–252）；系统记录产生日期。None 保留未到期信号；信号到期本身不会卖出持仓。示例发布六日动量信号。
framework.portfolio_construction: 返回目标或 None。示例结合当前持仓和活跃信号，仅在评分提升达到阈值时买入更优候选。无更新时持仓和漂移保持不变。
framework.risk_management: 每次收盘均运行，即使没有新建议。返回 {mode: "limit_positions", reason, position_limits} 限制持有股数；没有建议时，未列出的持仓保持股数。返回 {mode: "replace", reason, target} 可替换建议，target: None 可取消建议。None 不改变新建议。示例只退出 exit_instruments 所列证券；空列表不作调整。

cost.title: 费用与滑点
cost.help: 费用设置在本次回测及其 DailyTrack 中冻结。默认值是模拟假设，实际券商和历史费用可能不同。

labels.commission_min_cny: 每笔子委托最低佣金（元）

helpText.commission_min_cny: 对每笔已成交子委托分别收取，包括拆单。
helpText.slippage_bps: 10 基点使买价上升、卖价下降 0.1%；必须小于 10,000 基点。

drawdown.title: 组合回撤
drawdown.help: 三个字段全部留空表示关闭。启用后须填写所有字段。收盘账户价值与当前风险周期峰值比较；下一开盘应用股票仓位上限。
drawdown.recovery: 冷却期从触发日之后开始。解除限制还需要新的组合决策，不会按旧目标自动买回。上限只压低更高的目标。执行可能受阻，主报告的开盘收益历史不会重置。

takeProfit.title: 累计止盈
takeProfit.help: 未设置层级时关闭。首次触发时冻结持仓基准。30% 后接 60% 的层级，是再卖出基准的 30%，不是剩余持仓的 60%。完全退出前，普通选股不能追加持仓。
takeProfit.footer: 两个百分比须随层级递增。收盘时按取得成本检查，下一开盘的成交决定实际进度；受阻卖出和取整未成交部分不计为完成。

frozen.feesHelp: 最低佣金适用于每笔已成交子委托。滑点改变成交价格，不会再作为费用重复收取。
frozen.python: 冻结的 Python 源码与参数
frozen.drawdownSummary: 阈值 {{threshold}}%；股票仓位上限 {{cap}}%；冷却期 {{cooldown}} 个交易日。解除限制需要新的组合决策。
